_comment: Item definitions. Ported from the Rails InventoryItem STI subclasses (wood became carbon). category: material | lootbox | placeable. Items with a lootTable can be opened with the Use action. Items with stackSize 1 get a unique instance id.

items.tooltip: Elementary carbon, injected through the event horizon. Light, versatile, and the backbone of most structures.
Elementary iron, injected through the event horizon. Dense and strong.
A sealed package of compressed matter. Nobody is quite sure what the pocket universe will put inside. Use it to find out.
A graphite-lined radiation chamber. Graphite moderates neutrons. Deploy it into the grid.
A steel-plated radiation chamber. Deploy it into the grid.
